correctness.rationale: The tracked consensus/disagreement reduction yields the exact 3×3 M and cubic P(z)=z³+a z²+b z+c; independently reconstructed its determinant and P(1)=β(1−λ)². For contrast u=e², S=1−b+ac−c² is concave in u and both u=0,1 endpoint formulas remain strictly positive for 0<λ<1 and 0<β<2. Therefore a nonreal unit-circle crossing is impossible. P(1)>0 excludes +1, so only P(−1)=−Q(β) permits crossing; Q has a single root B* inside (0,2) if e>0 and none if e=0, giving exact radical formula. At boundary the root −1 is simple; for β>B*, a real eigenvalue is <-1. The explicit admissible-initialization left-eigenvector contradiction ensures the unstable/critical modes are reachable from y0=Hx0. Independent SymPy determinant and 27 sample eigenvalue/frontier classifications corroborated the algebra, not its continuum proof. No negative-λ, >2-agent, or β≥2 extrapolation follows.
